# Acme Docs

> Documentation for the Acme widget platform.

# Install
> Install the Acme CLI in one minute.

```bash
npm i -g acme
```

Then run `acme init`.

---

> Every endpoint, with examples.

## GET /widgets

Returns the widget list.
